name: Grave Robbers
source: Sylvania Supplement, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/grave-robbers) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: The head of the gang of body-snatchers. Each warband must have one Graver.

specialRules.note: The page does not state the Leader rule explicitly; the Graver is the warband's only compulsory Hero.

heroSlots.notes: Seasoned diggers who loot the tombs of Sylvania. 0-2.
A student surgeon who buys bodies from the gang and patches up its members. 0-1. Only he can use the Surgeon's Journal.

specialRules.name: Sawbones
specialRules.description: After a battle, may re-roll one friendly Hero's Serious Injury result; the second result stands. Cannot be used if the Junior Medic was taken out of action during the battle.

heroSlots.notes: Youngsters who keep watch while the others dig. 0-2.

henchmenTypes.notes: Hired muscle for the dig. Bought in groups of 1-5; any number, within the 15-model warband limit.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Pry Bar
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Grave Robbers warband only; Heroes only.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user. Counts as a club. Parry: the wielder may parry blows as with a sword.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Hooded Lantern & Rig
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only. 15 gc at founding (Hero list); later 15 + D6 gc, Rare 9.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Concealed Light: works as a normal Lantern, but enemy models cannot see the bearer because of it. Free-hand: the rig leaves the bearer's hands free.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Surgeon's Journal
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only; its effect is used by the Junior Medic. 80 gc at founding (Hero list); later 80 + 4D6 gc, Rare 11.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Skilled Hand: instead of using Sawbones, the Medic may modify one friendly model's Serious Injury die by +1 or -1.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Finger Pendant
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Grave Robbers warband only; Heroes only.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Death-Ward: a one-use 5+ save against a Necromantic or Dark Arts spell.

specialRules: Grave Goods: In the Exploration phase, gain +1 gc for each enemy model taken out of action during the battle. | Shady Reputation: May not hire Bounty Hunters, Roadwardens, Law-Enforcers, Holy Men or any Follower of Morr. | Undead Foes: All members of the warband Hate Undead models. | Shovels: The Shovel on the equipment lists is a Halberd (10 gc).
